article_title: Evaluating Fundamentals of Vaginal Surgery for Use Among Obstetrics and Gynecology Residents in Accra, Ghana.
citation: Bangura Marie, Ganyaglo Gabriel, Kupualor David, Boateng Alex, Sepenu Perez, Koranteng Isaac, Lawrence Emma R., Rooney Deborah, Schmidt Payton. (2025). Evaluating Fundamentals of Vaginal Surgery for Use Among Obstetrics and Gynecology Residents in Accra, Ghana. International Urogynecology Journal. https://doi.org/10.1007/s00192-025-06343-3
title: Fundamentals of Vaginal Surgery (FVS) simulation system
description: The Fundamentals of Vaginal Surgery (FVS) simulation system is a surgical skills trainer comprising "a 3D-printed task trainer and disposable simulated inserts" designed to teach and maintain basic vaginal surgery skills. Users watch a standardized instructional video, then perform timed tasks (including one-handed and two-handed knot tying, plication suturing, and pedicle ligation) with penalties for errors or exceeding cutoff times. In this study it was used to assess baseline skills of 34 Ghanaian Ob/Gyn residents, and the authors conclude it "could be used as a valuable tool for both teaching and assessing surgical skills" in this setting.
requirements: Users watch a standardized instructional video demonstrating how to perform each task before performing it
constraints: The original six-task protocol was modified for this study: running suturing was removed and tasks were performed twice rather than three times
target_learners: Ob/Gyn residents in a 3-year training program
target_learning_goals: Basic vaginal surgical skills including knot tying, suturing, and pedicle ligation
examples: Residents at the Accra teaching hospital completed five timed FVS tasks after watching instructional videos, with performance scored by trained Ob/Gyn fellow evaluators
